title: People's
tagline: Project People's - Decentralised Social Media Platform that Connects People from Web 2.0 and Web 3.0
description: A decentralised social media application, that helps users to connect with a MetaMask wallet or Sequence wallet. The application contains channels that are ERC-20 and ERC-721 token-gated. Users that do not have any NFTs or tokens, will still be able to create their profile, and read some posts. Additionally, our application lets users take full ownership of their content, sell the rights to their posts, support others by sending them some funds in cryptocurrencies, and even send encrypted messages using Lit Protocol. Users can also add others, to their friend list and call them directly, thanks to Live Peer Protocol.
how_its_made: The frontend is created in React with TypeScript and UI/UX Design with Figma. For more efficient and consistent UI we have used ChakraUI. Users connect with web 3.0 wallet or Sequence wallet if they do not have a pre-installed wallet. Lens Protocol is used for profiles, creating channels and the following module. Moralis is used as our backend and a database. Our application lets users take full ownership of their content, sell the rights to their posts, support others by sending them some funds in cryptocurrencies, and even send encrypted messages using Lit Protocol. Users can also add others, to their friend list and call them directly, thanks to Live Peer Protocol.
